facade.description: The ultimate stealth role. Has access to every room in the Mega-Corp, but nobody looks twice at them.

secret.description: 6 invisible telekinetic tendrils attached to their psyche/aura. Each tendril MUST be doing something/touching something, or Luckii starts losing sanity. If not in control, the tendrils act independently unless Luckii is asleep or tranquilized. The tendrils have names and moods that mutually influence Luckii's brain moods. They must be appeased.
